name: Kono Sora ga Tsuieru Toki ni
original_name: この空がついえる瞬間に
source:
Main character lives happily with his lover and friends around him. But one day the world comes to an end. Protagonist's brother is looking for a leader in this crumbling post-apocalypse world and he finds the leader in protagonist's lover Sena who undergoes transformation suitable to call her God's child... The two people keep on living happily. However, the fate is not smiling at them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与恋人和朋友们幸福地生活在一起。然而某天，世界迎来终结。在这个逐渐崩坏的末日世界里，主人公的哥哥正在寻找一位领袖，并最终选中了主人公的恋人濑奈；她经历了足以被称作‘神之子’的转变…两人继续幸福地生活着，可命运并未向他们微笑。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
